modules.name: Bitbucket Pipelines
modules.description: Run a repository's custom pipelines, such as deploys, after a preview of what is live and what will run.

modules.name: Bitbucket pull requests
modules.description: Review the diff of Bitbucket Cloud PRs the agent links in a session, then merge them after live checks and your confirmation, without opening Bitbucket.

modules.name: Microsoft Teams
modules.description: Puts Teams requests meant for you in the Inbox (direct messages, @mentions, replies to your channel posts), and lets the agent search and read Teams while it works. Reads Teams through the Composio CLI signed in on this desktop.
